name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.mem_srcArcs
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (e : Prod.{0, 0} Nat Nat),
  Iff (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.srcArcs g) e)
    (∃ j,
      And
        (LT.lt.{0} j
          (List.length.{0}
            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))))
        (And (Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.isSrcNode g j) Bool.true)
          (Eq.{1} e
            (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.netS g)
              (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.repOf g j))))))

source.code:
theorem mem_srcArcs (e : ℕ × ℕ) : e ∈ g.srcArcs ↔
    ∃ j, j < g.base.nodes.length ∧ g.isSrcNode j = true ∧ e = (g.netS, 2 * g.repOf j) := by
  rw [srcArcs, srcArcsL, ← List.mem_toFinset, dedupList_toFinset, List.mem_toFinset,
    List.mem_map]
  simp only [List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, repOf]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, ⟨hj, hs⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, hj, hs, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, hs, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, ⟨hj, hs⟩, rfl⟩
